title: Finite-time blow-up for the Calogero--Sutherland derivative NLS on $\mathbb{T}$
summary: We study finite-time blow-up for the focusing Calogero--Sutherland derivative NLS on the torus with smooth initial data in the Hardy space $L^2_+(\mathbb{T})$. For finite-gap potentials as initial data, the explicit solution formula reduces the dynamics to a finite-dimensional analytic family of contractions.
